screening_batch.purpose: Independent-parent partial goal cancellation grounded in an oven-preparation activity.

original_annotations.narration: Grab the salmon skewer again and move from the packaging to the baking tray with the right hand.
Grab the salmon skewer again and move from the packaging to the baking tray with the right hand.
Because there is not enough space in the baking tray, adjust the placements of the salmon skewers to make space for the fourth salmon skewer.
With both hands, move the skewers around to make sure they are spaced out enough in the baking tray.
Change mind and instead grab the larger baking tray from the kitchen stove with the right hand.
With the left hand move the kitchen foil out of the way.
With the right hand, place the larger baking tray on the kitchen counter.
With both hands, lift up the foil that has salmon skewers on it and move it from the smaller baking tray to the right side of the larger baking tray.
Place the foil down and flatten it out on the larger baking tray.
With the right hand, adjust the placements of the salmon skewers to make sure they are well spaced on the baking tray.
With both hands, pick up the baking tray to move it to the oven.

observed_events.description: Food skewers are moved from their retail package onto foil lining a rigid dark baking tray. The foil and food are then lifted together into another rigid dark baking tray; the reusable support and the removable roll-supplied lining are visually separate objects.

visual_review.review_mode: Ordered sampled overview and native-resolution inspection of all eight released frames; not a claim of full native-rate watching.

screening_lineage.prior_rejection: decisive_attribute_unreadable: two baking trays could not support an honest exact-size listing swap.
screening_lineage.repair: This separate category-level partial drop does not distinguish the two trays by guessed size or brand. It identifies the reusable baking support and removable foil, then removes only the user-cancelled supply.

screening.before: One reusable single-tray product matching the visible overall outline, plus one separately selected roll-form lining product, is required.
screening.after: Remove the roll-form lining product and keep the one scene-matching spare tray; a non-tray rack or mat bundled with that single tray remains allowed.
screening.real_user_need: Only one spare tray is missing for food preparation; avoid buying extra trays while allowing a useful rack/mat. Cancel the separately selected lining because the user already has enough.

instruction_freeze.note: 2026-10-18 material rewrite after an independently proven no_scene counterexample. Reuses the same96 real frozen results and original8 released frames; no new capture or fabricated website fact.

supported_claims.text: The released frames show food supported by foil in a rigid baking tray whose overall outline is elongated and approximately rectangular with rounded corners. This is an outline claim, not an exact-size, wall-height or handle-model claim.
The food-support tray and removable roll-supplied foil lining are separate visible objects, so the user can buy them separately and later cancel only the lining purchase.

unsupported_claims: The source records the authored shopping request.
Exact observed tray dimensions, brand or metal alloy.
Full native-frame-rate source playback was watched.

construct.research_question: Can an agent cancel a separately ordered consumable while retaining a single spare tray whose overall outline must be matched from the scene?

instructions.a: I'm short of one spare tray for this prep. Add one reusable tray matching the overall shape of the one holding the food here; brand, colour and exact size can differ. No multi-tray bakeware sets; a rack or mat is fine. Also add the lining material used in it, on a roll; any pack size is fine.
instructions.b: I already have enough lining material. Remove that item and keep the spare tray.
instructions.bundled: I'm short of one spare tray for this prep. Add one reusable tray matching the overall shape of the one holding the food here; brand, colour and exact size can differ. No multi-tray bakeware sets; a rack or mat is fine. Also add the lining material used in it, on a roll; any pack size is fine. I already have enough lining material. Remove that item and keep the spare tray.

observed.why: The new A requires one scene-outline-matching spare tray plus separate roll-form lining. B cancels only that lining product; the tray and its allowed non-tray accessories remain.

construct.belief_before: One reusable single-tray product matching the visible overall outline, plus one separately selected roll-form lining product, is required.
construct.belief_after: Remove the roll-form lining product and keep the one scene-matching spare tray; a non-tray rack or mat bundled with that single tray remains allowed.
construct.required_behavior_change: Remove only the separately selected lining product and retain one matching spare tray.
construct.no_update_failure: Retain the separately selected lining product after its cancellation.
construct.overupdate_failure: Delete the spare tray, or discard a one-tray product merely because it includes a rack or mat.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The user leaves the spare tray's overall outline to the scene. Released original-resolution frames show an elongated rounded-corner rectangular baking tray, whereas the public window also contains a single square pan and multi-shape bakeware sets. Brand, colour, exact size and wall height are not matched; the explicit one-tray need excludes multi-tray products without banning non-tray accessories.

equivalence_review.policy: Accept one reusable rigid tray per product whose overall outline is an elongated rectangle (rounded or square corners); brand, colour, material, coating, exact size, wall height, rim and handle layout are not conditions. A product whose title or listing image presents two or more trays/pans (pack, set, 'N pans + N racks', mixed sizes) is a multi-tray set and is rejected, whatever its accessories. Non-tray accessories bundled with one tray (rack, grid, mat, cover) are allowed. Square pans, disposable foil pans/cups and accessory-only listings (racks, mats, covers, parchment) are not the tray. The provisional lining role accepts kitchen aluminum foil on rolls, any roll size or pack count; pre-cut sheets are not rolls.

equivalence_review.policy: Accept reusable rigid metal baking trays across sizes, rectangular or square shape, depth, color, coating, and same-type pack counts. Do not infer tray dimensions or an aspect-ratio cutoff from the video. Matching racks are normal tray accessories. A mixed bakeware kit with unrelated cake/loaf/muffin forms is not a same-type tray pack. Tray packages including silicone lining mats remain unwanted lining supplies after the update. Thin formed disposable foil containers are not the reusable rigid tray. The provisional lining role accepts kitchen aluminum foil supplied on rolls, any roll dimensions or pack count; pre-cut folded sheets are not rolls.

semantic_review.checked_scope: 完整96标题，50可重复烤盘/套装图片；3新增套装可证实，3既有深烤模作为合理替代保留但类型边界待独立定向确认。
